name: wallstreet-tieling
description: Enterprise intelligence and risk discovery system for evidence-first due diligence workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-first enterprise risk discovery and due diligence.
interface.longDescription: Wallstreet Tieling turns a company name into a structured investigative workflow: public or authorized data sources, evidence records, entity graphs, risk events, timelines, monitoring deltas, and report-ready findings. It is built for information equality, provenance, and practical risk discovery rather than ungrounded summaries.
defaultPrompt: Investigate a company and build an evidence graph.
Run an explicit baseline re-check and explain new signals; continuous monitoring is later-version scope.
Audit a datasource connector for provenance quality.
